subject: Energy drinks
hook: ENERGY DRINKS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: In India the label “energy drink” has no legal definition—regulators say the term is misleading and have barred its use, so most products called energy drinks are just high‑caffeine beverages marketed under a deceptive name.
angle_support: "the regulator ... does not recognise the category as no formal standards define 'energy drinks'" (source 2)
"India had never established standards for an energy drink category" (source 3)
title: Why India Banned The Term Energy Drink
description: Discover why regulators in India have cracked down on the term 'energy drink' and why it is considered a misleading label for high-caffeine beverages.
narration: ENERGY DRINKS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a specialized beverage that provides a genuine boost of energy. It was closer to a marketing trick, as the term lacks any formal legal definition. India’s food regulator explicitly barred the use of this label, accusing major manufacturers of deliberately using the phrase to dupe consumers. These products are simply high-caffeine sodas, not a distinct, scientifically regulated category of functional drinks. The label is just a deceptive name for standard caffeinated soda.
